mapper.select: SELECT tm.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, tm.shop_id AS shopId, CASE WHEN tm.shop_id = 0 THEN t.tenant_name ELSE s.shop_name END AS shopName, tm.id AS memberId, tm.member_type AS memberType, CASE WHEN tm.shop_id = 0 THEN 'TENANT' ELSE 'SHOP' END AS workspaceType FROM tenant_member tm INNER JOIN tenant t ON t.id = tm.tenant_id LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id = tm.shop_id AND s.tenant_id = tm.tenant_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 1 AND tm.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status = 1 AND ( tm.shop_id = 0 OR s.status = 1 ) ORDER BY tm.tenant_id, tm.shop_id
